title: Evidence storage configuration
responsibility: Resolves required R2 settings while allowing isolated temporary test stores to omit remote storage.

outputs.name: r2EvidenceConfig
outputs.description: Complete R2 configuration, or undefined for an allowed temporary local-only store or an unconfigured temporary test store. Reads environment and the configured adapter configuration file, except that test mode does not pass the file override.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Throws when local-only storage is requested outside a temporary descendant directory, required R2 settings are missing, or an endpoint override is not an HTTP 127.0.0.1 server with an explicit port.
